_hooks_note: Deliberately EMPTY, matching the `claude` (project) target in FLOSS/shared-hook-surface.json. Claude Code merges user-scope and project-scope hooks -- both fire, it is not most-specific-wins -- so with the `claude_user` target materialized into ~/.claude/settings.json, duplicating the pre/post-write hooks here made every substantive edit run them TWICE and submit duplicate durable Claims to the source chain. This file is a hand-maintained mirror for sessions launched from FLOSS/, not a materializer output, which is how it drifted from the manifest. Keep it in step with the `claude` target by hand, or make it a target.
